programme.title: Ski jumping: World Cup competition in Ruka
programme.desc: The Rukatunturi ski jumping hill is not the most fortunate facility for the Polish representatives. So far, none of them has managed to win the competition held there. However, the White and Reds stood on the podium several times. The last time they did this was in November 2020, when Piotr Żyła took second place and Dawid Kubacki third. How will our Eagles do this time? Coach Thomas Thurnbichler made many changes to the team's preparation plan for the World Cup. All this to prevent a season as unsuccessful as the previous one from happening again. One of the innovations was more individualized training. We hope that all these efforts will bring results and the Polish representatives will bring a lot of joy to the fans again

programme.title: I was the king – Marcin Robak | S01E06
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Marcin Robak is a two-time top scorer in the Ekstraklasa. He is the last Pole to win this title so far. In total, he scored 120 goals in the top league. Marcin Robak scored 22 goals for Pogoń Szczecin in the 2013/2014 season. He finished the 2016/2017 season in Lech Poznań with 18 goals. He then had to share the crown with Marco Paixao. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

Giants That Are No More – Secrets of the Tyrannosaurus Rex | S01E01
programme.desc: The program reveals the secrets of the largest beasts that have ever lived on our planet. Viewers will look at deadly tyrannosaurs, saber-toothed tigers and sea monsters. The latest research will reveal, among other things, how these giant animals evolved, why they were so large and what caused their extinction. Viewers will explore a unique excavation site in America and learn why the Tyrannosaurus became the king of the dinosaurs. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Primates – The Secret to Survival | E01
programme.desc: A documentary series devoted to our favorite primates, presenting species that are rarely shown on screen. Modern technology has enabled creators to capture their world from a unique perspective and in their natural environment, whether it is the treetops of a flood forest or the dense bushes shrouded in the darkness of a Sri Lankan night. Over the course of two years, the filmmakers undertook twenty-eight expeditions around the world, braving snowstorms in the Moroccan Atlas Mountains and wading through flooded jungles in remote corners of Sumatra and Brazil. They were among the first in history to immortalize the newly discovered Tapanuli orangutan species and were the first in years to attempt to film a white uakari. One team spent over two months in Equatorial Guinea, camping on a remote beach to record the most intimate scenes from the life of a mandrill, one of the least understood primates in the world. In Sri Lanka, thanks to low-light technology, the first color images of mysterious gray loris in the wild were captured at night. Captivating animal stories combine real family drama with cutting-edge science. A seemingly terrifying silver-backed mountain gorilla encountered on the volcanic slopes of the Congo turns out to be a gentle and caring father to its young. According to the latest research, it is caring fathers who achieve the greatest reproductive success. Viewers will also see South Africa's elusive pygmy galago, part of a recently discovered urban population, as it raids the local zoo at night. In Malaysia, they will learn about the world of treetops from the perspective of white-handed gibbons, shown on screen for the first time in history. The unique series is narrated by naturalist Chris Packham. Among the fog-covered slopes of volcanoes in the Congo Basin live some of the largest and most famous primates. Among them is a silver-backed mountain gorilla that uses a surprising strategy. He bases his domination and power on a bold show of force, thanks to which he maintains order in the family's life. However, when the offspring refuses to respect the father's authority, the dangerous tyrant reveals his gentler face. It turns out that this dangerous leader is more than just an aggressive guardian of the hearth. He can also be gentle and sensitive. Recent research shows that an alpha male must demonstrate more than just strength to be successful. Meanwhile, hard times have come for the herd of bearded capuchin monkeys living in the Brazilian highlands. The sun-baked canyons there haven't seen a drop of rain in eight months. However, monkeys have found a solution to the lack of food and water - they catch lizards, which are a source of protein and water, and also eat wild cashew nuts, which are rich in fats and minerals. In South Africa, nocturnal galagos are also searching for missing food. In Pretoria, under the cover of darkness, they raid the city zoo. While the park's predatory inhabitants sit in cages, the galagos can roam around without fear. Clever animals have learned to navigate zoos with an unusual trick to help them do so - they smear sticky drops of urine on their hands and feet to leave a trail of scent behind them and at the same time give their limbs extra traction for jumping. In India's Western Ghats, lion macaques have abandoned cooperation in favor of a strategy based on the exploitation of other animals. Giant squirrels have an excellent sense of smell adapted to recognize ripe jackfruit, so clever macaques allow them to use it to then steal the prey from the squirrels. Lemurs living in Madagascar constitute one fifth of all primates. This island is also the only place in the world where they can be found. Like many primates, lemurs are attacked by ticks and other parasites. However, we meet a group of blue-eyed lemurs that have developed a brilliant way of dealing with pests - self-medication. USA, Great Britain. 2020. documentary film

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Hugo Sánchez» Hugo Sánchez Márquez shares with Leo Messi the honor of being the only two footballers alive to have won five top scorer trophies in the Championship. The same as Di Stéfano and Quini and one less than the legendary Telmo Zarra, six. He arrived from Mexico to sign for Atlético de Madrid where he scored 54 goals in 111 games and won his first Pichichi trophy. In 1985 he signed for Real Madrid, where he achieved his greatest collective and individual successes. He won five consecutive Leagues, a Copa del Rey, three Spanish Super Cups and a UEFA Cup. He also won four more trophies for the championship's top scorer. His bicycle kick goal against Logronés, his famous somersaults every time he celebrated a goal or the fact of being able to score 38 goals in a season, all with the first touch, were some of the images and feats that Hugo Sanchez left us and that will always be part of the historical memory of LaLiga

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Hugo Sánchez

programme.title: 30 for 30: Survive and Advance
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Megacities. Mumbai
programme.desc: It is called the "city of gold". Mumbai is a city of glamor and luxury, from its oldest stock exchange in Asia to Asia's largest film industry. It is the largest, richest and most dynamic city in India. Millions of people come here in hopes of making their dreams come true. And for these people to move, Mumbai must move too. More than any other city in the world, public transport in Mumbai is its circulatory system. Mumbai's trains and buses manage to keep up the pace of life for now, but by 2020 its current 13 million residents will become 20 million. Mumbai will become the most populous city in the world. Will this metropolis be able to survive, or will it turn into one big traffic jam? Starring: Paterson Joseph, Claudia Sheinbaum, Jacobo Zabludovsky, Tk Singh, Juan Manuel Espinoza, Pedro Ferríz de Con, Arturo Aispuro, Jackie Chan. UK, USA, 2006

programme.title: d/s Megacities. Paris

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. Fatal landing
programme.desc: On a flight from Amsterdam to Cardiff, the crew of KLM Cityhopper Flight 433 reports an engine problem and heads back to the airport, but just as the plane is about to touch down, it lists sharply to the right, its wing scrapes the ground, and it literally breaks apart near the runway. Of the 24 people on board, two passengers and the captain die. Experts from the Dutch Safety Council, who were searching for the causes of the disaster, establish the fact that one of the elements of the electronic control system failed, which led to a chain of fatal consequences. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003-present documentary

programme.title: d/s Air crash investigations. Deadly decline
programme.desc: While flying from Indonesia to Hong Kong, Cathay Pacific Flight 780 lifts over the South China Sea when both engines fail, forcing the captain of the Airbus A-330 to go into glide mode - all with a 200-tonne machine! Determined to avoid crashing into the ocean, the captain takes manual control of the plane and, by slowly pulling back on the throttle, manages to start one engine, but the malfunctioning engine prevents him from slowing down to land. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003-present documentary

The authors of the series invite you on a fascinating journey through the city, where among the skyscrapers and highways there is an incredible diversity of wildlife, including rare species that were caught on camera for the first time. Singapore, 2020

programme.desc: Chương trình đưa các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào vòng đấm bốc của người nổi tiếng. Tuy nhỏ tuổi, nhưng giống như những công dân khác của thành phố New York, những chàng trai nhỏ bé này đều ôm những giấc mơ lớn.

programme.title: BÁT PHỐ HÀ NỘI - BOWL OF HANOI, TẬP 05

Không chỉ gắn liền với những câu chuyện văn hóa ẩm thực, món ăn này còn là đại diện cho tinh thần của người Hà Nội: tinh tế, nhẹ nhàng nhưng rất đỗi cầu kỳ.

Qua những trải nghiệm lạ lẫm này, Thiên An dần thấu hiểu và trân trọng hơn những hy sinh của vợ mình.

programme.title: YÊU NHAU MÙA Ế - LOW SEASON
programme.desc: Yêu Nhau Mùa 'Ế' kể về Lin, một cô gái có khả năng nhìn thấy ma quỷ. Sau khi chia tay bạn trai, cô tìm bình yên ở một homestay vắng vẻ ở vùng Bắc và gặp Pud, một biên kịch trẻ tuổi. Dù phải đối mặt với sự đeo bám của các linh hồn, nhưng họ vẫn dần cảm thấy gần gũi và trót yêu nhau.

programme.title: HOA THIÊN CỐT - THE JOURNEY OF FLOWER
programme.desc: Hoa Thiên Cốt, quyết tâm thay đổi số phận nghiệt ngã, trải qua muôn vàn thử thách để bái Bạch Tử Họa làm sư phụ. Nàng thầm yêu chàng, còn chàng – thủ lĩnh Trường Lưu – cũng dần động lòng. Tuy nhiên, vì đại nghĩa, Bạch Tử Họa chấp nhận hy sinh, còn Hoa Thiên Cốt nguyện bên chàng đến cùng. Tình yêu, lòng dũng cảm và ý chí kiên cường giúp họ vượt qua mọi nghịch cảnh. Liệu mối duyên này có đủ mạnh mẽ để chống lại số phận?

programme.title: BÁT PHỐ HÀ NỘI - BOWL OF HANOI, TẬP 06
programme.desc: Mảnh ghép cuối cùng của bức tranh ẩm thực Hà Thành muôn hình vạn trạng là những món chè xưa. Chứa đựng hương vị của đất trời trong từng hạt xôi dẻo thơm, từng giọt chè sánh mịn, các món chè truyền thống không chỉ là thức quà ăn chơi, mà còn là một nét văn hóa đầy duyên dáng của nguời Hà Nội.

programme.title: MEN SAY TÌNH YÊU - BREWING LOVE, TẬP 5
programme.desc: Chae Yong Joo, một cựu đặc nhiệm đầy nhiệt huyết, hiện là vua bán hàng của một công ty rượu. Cuộc sống của cô đảo lộn khi chi nhánh đứng trước nguy cơ đóng cửa. Nhiệm vụ của cô là bán loại bia đặc biệt của bậc thầy Yoon Min Joo, một người đàn ông sống ẩn dật. Sự xuất hiện của Yong Joo đã làm xáo trộn cuộc sống yên bình của anh.
